summary: John Kuo, 41, of Vail ('Johnny Tsunami') caught and killed in an avalanche on Marvin's in the East Vail Chutes, backcountry outside Vail Mountain's boundary; companions and others on scene recovered him and attempted resuscitation before authorities arrived; CAIC had issued an avalanche warning for the Vail-Summit region the prior day
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group, Vail Ski Patrol, Eagle County Sheriff's Office
notes: Eagle County SO responded ~12 p.m. Thursday; 4th Colorado avalanche fatality in less than a week (three Eagle residents died in the San Juans days earlier); CAIC preliminary report. Merged CAIC classic 2020-21 season table row. [run 550 merge: Eagle County Sheriff media-release URL (opened this run) added; corroborates the VMRG/VMRG-adjacent response detail.] Run 612 VMRG merge: SnowBrains writeup corroborates 2021-02-04 Marvin's slide (700-ft-wide, 1,000-vertical-ft, companion resuscitation efforts unsuccessful).
